About the Opportunity 
 
 About the Khoury College of Computer Sciences 

 Khoury College is committed to building a community of belonging among students, faculty and staff. We strongly encourage applicants from individuals with disabilities, veterans, and those with varied experiences and backgrounds. We invite you to join a fast-moving, ambitious college with an underlying mission that is driven by our motto of “CS for Everyone.” 

 About the Opportunity 
 The Security and Privacy Heterogeneous Environment for Reproducible Experimentation (SPHERE) is a newly funded National Science Foundation (NSF) mid-scale research infrastructure being built by the University of Southern California Information Sciences Institute and Northeastern University’s Khoury College of Computer Sciences. This research infrastructure will offer access to an unprecedented variety of hardware, software, and other resources relevant to cybersecurity and privacy research. These resources will be connected by a user-configurable network substrate and protected by security policies uniquely aligned with cybersecurity and privacy research needs.

 The Research Engineer will help build this innovative cyberinfrastructure. The portion of SPHERE being developed at Northeastern University will focus on Internet of Things (IoT) device experimentation. The primary goal is to create the world’s largest remotely accessible IoT testbed, composed of dozens of samples of IoT devices across several categories and manufacturers, including smart speakers, smart televisions, and smart cameras.

 In addition to hosting IoT devices, the SPHERE IoT testbed will provide programming interfaces for interacting with devices through all available modalities, including physical access, companion application access, and voice access. These interfaces will be remotely accessible, allowing users worldwide to interact with devices and conduct experiments without purchasing devices or building their own infrastructure. The IoT testbed will be complemented by tools for capturing network traffic produced by the devices, securely storing data, integrating with the broader SPHERE research infrastructure, and streamlining automated and repeatable experiments at scale.

 This is a unique opportunity to join a vibrant team and conduct groundbreaking research supporting scalable, large-scale virtual access to diverse IoT hardware. This is a research position and is on-site at the Boston campus.

 Northeastern University considers factors such as candidate work experience, education, and skills when extending an offer. Northeastern University provides a comprehensive benefits package for benefits-eligible employees, including medical, vision, dental, paid time off, tuition assistance, wellness and life benefits, retirement benefits, and commuting and transportation benefits. Visit https://hr.northeastern.edu/benefits/ for more information.

 Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities 
 Software Development Activities (70%): Design, implement, test, document, and maintain SPHERE software
 Support Activities (20%): Prepare project documentation and periodic reports, coordinate with project partners, and prepare and present testing demonstrations
 Learning (10%): Acquire and broaden knowledge of the technologies and development tools used by SPHERE
 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Required 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related area; this requirement may be waived based on relevant software development work experience
 Fluency in at least one programming language
 Experience with Linux and software development tools, such as Git
 Resourcefulness, initiative, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team
 
 Preferred 
 Experience or interest in system or network administration, the Internet of Things, and/or cybersecurity
 
 Required Documents
 Resume
 Cover Letter

Research
